enchantments.tooltip: +15 Enhancement Bonus: +15 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls.

Legendary Virulent Poison: This item carries a potent poison that is delivered with your attacks. On any strike, the Poison has a chance to be applied, dealing 5d6 Constitution damage if your enemy fails a DC100 Fortitude saving throw.
Keen: Passive: The base critical threat range of this weapon is doubled. This does not stack with Improved Critical feat. Vorpal Strikes by this weapon also bypass all Fortification.
Ranged Alacrity 20%: Gain 20% Enhancement bonus to Ranged attack speed. Does not stack with the Haste spell.
Poisonous 7: This effect causes the edges of this weapon to drip with a vile venom, dealing 7d6 poison damage on each hit.
